_legend.layer: closed/single: parent_info names the engine layer line (form layer_line / parent_links); form siblings = no player-text parent exists, the harness needs a sibling-set form (college gap 7); root: topics is a subset of the NPC's top-level rows when the group gave it, entries are the texts shown; approx = hand-built root (needs a speaker map)
_legend.expect: as spec 3.3; scene = read-only at clicks_ok 0, stageB = the class once driven; entry = only the click-free PROTOCOL 10.26 entry can do it; none = nothing to say (cannot / engine auto-continue); show = the menu is his (leave guard / never by voice)
_legend.say.via: pick | explicit | single | auto | check | park (spec 3.3); fp = true when the want=1 fast path does it on his words alone, false when it needs her T-key (the gate); src = verbatim | para | stt | probe
_legend.never: must click nothing on the fast path (green on the verifier build or re-checked on the 19:36 lib)
_legend.never_red: must click nothing, but it DOES click on the current build - a known defect the build has to fix (gap id in COVERAGE.md); assert as expected-fail until then
_legend.not_target: must not click the target (it names a sibling line and may click that one)
_legend.say_model: her words decide (she asks which of two lines)
_legend.misses: natural sentences that click nothing today (coverage misses, not assertions)
_legend.path: the coverage path: pick | ask_once | single | auto | check | service | scene_read_only | scripted_entry_candidate | open | leave_only | never_by_voice | cannot
_legend.group=brotherhood: converted from brotherhood.verified.json (content policy: no line text): layer.entries are info_keys (layer.entries_by = info_key), and a `t` holding "<index txt>" is a template the harness fills from the target row at run time (verbatim; "not now, <index txt> later"; "no, <index txt>"; "<index txt>?"; "wait, <index txt>?"; "is it true that <index txt>"). paraphrases with expect resolve / ask -> say, expect nothing -> misses; probes the verifier found clicking -> never_red (gap G1 / G5), the rest -> never; the near-miss -> near_miss (and never when it was green)
_legend.quarantine: reported by tools/test_questline.php --extended in its own table, never asserted (still_clicks: the lines the coverage re-check saw clicking)
_legend.no_line: Dark Brotherhood beats with no clickable player line (the verifier's `cannot` / `never_by_voice` / scene rows): counted with G17, not run
_legend.measure: rows added from research/pt19h-measure.json (src pt19h-measure): never_red rows of G1 G5 G9 G10 G11 (the fast path must stop clicking) and G13 G20 (path key: her T-key must stop releasing the line), resolve_red rows of G2 G3 G4 G6 G16 G18 (the line must be reached; reported by outcome).
